purpose: Permanent Slayer helmet craft chain (components + upgrades), Slayer Rewards toolbelt-attach unlocks for drop cleaners, ring of slaying craft, Slayer Codex, ferocious rings / Kuradal dungeon, and remaining Daemonheim gold-accumulator rewards missing from forinthry skilling rows. Fills audit ranks 1-2 and 36 (helmet chain, toolbelt attaches, ferocious fuse).

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks acquisition geography. region_hints marks multi-region craft/farm chains. required_regions only when both ends of a stack are hard gates. Do not re-emit forinthry:bonecrusher / charming-imp / herbicide / gem-bag / seedicide-not-daemonheim item rows — this file adds the permanent toolbelt-attach unlocks and missing gold accumulators.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman / Equilibrium no-trade framing: component farms and token/point sinks, not GE fills.
policy.rate_rule: Unlock state, point/token costs, and effects only. No invented kill times or XP/hour.
policy.duplicate_guard: Checked data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json — none of the ids in this file already exist. Item rows forinthry:bonecrusher, forinthry:charming-imp, forinthry:herbicide, forinthry:gem-bag*, seedicide-not-daemonheim, forinthry:scroll-of-* remain canonical for the items themselves.

activity_additions.name: Slayer helmet component farms
requirements: Smoking Kills for helmet craft unlock path
58 Slayer + Cabin Fever for Mos Le'Harmless cave/unspeakable horrors (black mask)
73 Slayer for jungle strykewyrms (hexcrest)
77 Slayer for desert strykewyrms (focus sight)
Profane Scabarites / Scabarites access for spectral lens (Necromancy style component)
80 Necromancy for ensoul spectral lens ritual (City of Um / ritual site)
unlocks: Black mask farm geography (melee helm component)
Focus sight farm geography (Ranged helm component)
Spectral lens farm + ensoul ritual path (Necromancy helm component)
Shop-bought protective pieces: spiny helmet, face mask, earmuffs, nose peg
activity_additions.notes: Planner activity hub for the full style-coverage helmet. Individual equipment rows below carry region_hint and effects. Spiny/face/earmuffs/nose peg are Slayer Master shop items (any master with stock) — not region-locked drops. Black mask also has a rare Shadow Reef sea-horror path (not the practical ironman farm).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Surface Morytania (horrors), Karamja (jungle strykewyrms), Desert (desert strykewyrms + profane scabarites), and Misthalin/City of Um (ensoul ritual) when ranking full-style helmet completion. Shop protection pieces are multi-master and not a hard single-region gate.

activity_additions.name: Slayer Codex and Sunken Pyramid soul system

Ushabti captures placed in chest of souls or personal Slayer dungeon

equipment_additions.name: Spectral lens
requirements: Profane Scabarite / Elite Profane Scabarite kills (Desert)
20 Necromancy, 20 Defence, Necromancy! quest to wear
On-task (Profane Scabarites or Scabarites) improves drop rate
effects: On task: +7.5% Necromancy damage and +12.5% Necromancy accuracy

Combined with uncharged black mask at 55 Crafting after Learn how to craft Slayer helmets

equipment_additions.name: Slayer helmet (craft unlock + base helm)
requirements: Smoking Kills completed
400 Slayer points: Learn how to craft Slayer helmets
55 Crafting (boostable; Assist System cannot craft)
35 Slayer (Smoking Kills gate)
Uncharged black mask + spiny helmet + face mask + earmuffs + nose peg
effects: Combines all protective piece effects into one head slot
On-task melee: +7.5% damage and +12.5% accuracy from black mask (base tier)
Can be disassembled into components and reassembled
Eligible for Slayer Lodge helmet stand (Anachronia tier 3) for passive task bonuses without wearing stats/teleports
equipment_additions.notes: Ironman guide top permanent. Point sink is global; black mask farm is Morytania-pressure; shop pieces multi-master. Base tier is melee-only damage/accuracy boost until full upgrade.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Track as multi-region permanent. Component farms still apply regional pressure (especially Morytania black mask).

equipment_additions.name: Full slayer helmet and point upgrades (reinforced through corrupted)
requirements: Base slayer helmet owned
Hexcrest + focus sight for full slayer helmet (all combat styles at base 7.5%/12.5%)
Optional ensouled spectral lens for Necromancy on full+
First upgrades: reinforced 100 pts, strong 400, mighty 600, corrupted 1,000 (+ corrupted gem)
Re-upgrade costs are 10% of first-upgrade cost after initial purchase
Defence gates: full 20, reinforced 30, strong 50, mighty/corrupted 70
effects: Full: on-task +7.5% damage / +12.5% accuracy for Melee, Magic, and Ranged (Necromancy with ensouled lens)
Reinforced: +8% damage / +13% accuracy
Mighty: +9% / +14%
Corrupted: +9.5% / +14.5% (highest helm tier)
Higher tiers improve Defence armour tier and unlock more ferocious-ring fuse capacity
equipment_additions.notes: Single planner ladder for full → reinforced → strong → mighty → corrupted. Corrupted gem is a Desert / Sophanem-style pressure on the final step — verify current gem sources in-league. Anachronia Slayer Lodge stand accepts placed helmets for passive bonuses without worn stats/teleports/ring effects.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Multi-region: Karamja hexcrest + Desert focus sight (and spectral lens) feed full; point upgrades are global; stand is Anachronia.
